sentences.text:
The offences alleged are under Sections 363, 370A, 376, 376(3), 376(2)(n)
of IPC, Sections 4(2) r/w 3(a), 6(1) r/w 5(1) of the PoCSO Act, Section 84 of the JJ Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST POA Act.
2. This Court has granted bail to the petitioner as per Annexure A1 order dated 15.1.2025.

One of the conditions imposed in Annexure A1 bail order is that, he shall not enter the Taluk where the victim and witnesses are residing, till the conclusion of the trial in Crime No.117/2024.
3.
According to the petitioner, because of the above condition, he could not go to his residence which situates in Thodupuzha Taluk.
Therefore, he prayed for lifting the above condition.
According to the petitioner, though he moved the Special Judge Devikulam for lifting the above condition, the said application was dismissed as per Annexure A2 order.
Aggrieved by the said order he approached this Court.
4. The learned Public Prosecutor upon instructions, submitted that, 2025:KER:84972 CRL.M.C.NO.7992 OF 2025 so far the petitioner has not violated the bail conditions.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that, the trial of the case is not commenced and there is no likelihood of commencement of the trial in the near future.
The learned counsel also submitted that the residence of the petitioner is about 8 k.m. away from that of the victim.

In the above circumstance, I hold that this Crl.M.C. can be disposed of limiting the rigor of condition No.5 in Annexure A1 order as follows;
The petitioner shall not try to contact, influence or intimidate the defacto complainant and witnesses and shall not enter within one kilometers from the place of residence of the victim till the disposal of S.C.No.198/2024 on the file of Fast Track Court, Devikulam.
Sd/-
 C. PRATHEEP KUMAR,
